summary: Iteration 9 — Launch App perf fixes verified end-to-end. On throttled 4G (1.6Mbps / 150ms RTT) the Cadabra app reveals (html.bf-ready) in 1.09s desktop and 1.32s mobile after clicking the landing hero launch; full nav (dk-nav-private / mobile tabbar) visible in 5.94s desktop / 5.14s mobile. The landing CTAs go DIRECTLY to the backend shim (`${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/bifrost/v1/app/`, no React bundle hop) and the address bar is rewritten to <host>/app after the shim runs — verified for landing-launch-hero. Inline fast-path in public/index.html correctly redirects /swap → /app#private-route, /track?id=abc → /app#track/abc, /about → /, /app → /api/bifrost/v1/app/, /app#privacy-swap preserved. Backend logo endpoint /api/bifrost/v1/indexer/v1/logo/<mint> returns 200 image/webp 1106 bytes, 96x96 (previously ~863KB) — repeat fetch returns same size (cached). No 'Veil' branding flash: body.innerText contains no 'Veil' at bf-ready nor 500ms later. All backend acceptance tests pass (4/4 pytest).
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/public/index.html inline fast-path: regex /^\/(app|shield)(\/.*)?$/ handles /app and /shield, then explicit branches for /swap, /track, /about. The /about branch inside the /(app|shield) regex redirects to '/' when path is '/app/about' — which is the documented behaviour but could surprise users deep-linking from docs; worth a code comment.

backend/bifrost.py logo downscale from ~860KB to ~1.1KB (780x compression) is excellent; the 96x96 WebP target hits the sweet spot for both desktop and mobile asset lists. Consider adding a Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400 on logo responses (ingress currently forces no-store so client-side it's irrelevant, but when ingress is relaxed this would help).

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 pytest: logo WebP downscale + cache stability + fast-path HTML + /app shim)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the targeted perf acceptance criteria (bf-ready + dk-nav-private + tabbar + URL rewrite + redirects + no-Veil-flash)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Perf fixes shipped and verified. Landing launch buttons href = ${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/bifrost/v1/app/ (direct backend shim). Inline fast-path in public/index.html runs BEFORE React boot and handles /app, /shield, /swap, /track?id=, /about. Backend logo downscale to <=96px WebP + cache delivers ~1KB payloads. If retesting, note that logo tags only mount AFTER wallet creation (asset list / Vanish right panel) — iteration 8 already verified they render with naturalWidth>0; this iteration verified the endpoint directly. React #418 hydration warning may appear (per request note) — did not break the page in any run.
rca of the issue: Original user complaint 'clicking launch app takes so long to load' root-caused in prior iterations to (a) content being hidden until window 'load' event (every image/font must finish — ~7s fallback), (b) landing-launch CTAs rendering React landing before the backend-shim redirect, and (c) upstream token logos ~860KB each saturating slow networks. Iter-9 fixes verified: (1) landing CTAs now href straight to /api/bifrost/v1/app/, saving the React bundle round-trip, (2) reveal moved from window 'load' to DOMContentLoaded (fallback cut to 2.5s), (3) logos re-encoded to 96x96 WebP (~1.1KB, 780x smaller) and micro-cached. Result: app reveal under 1.5s on throttled 4G in both desktop and mobile viewports.
